svg.title: The notes of a release in your language
svg.desc: The checks of a release pull request pass, and the pager shows its message at once, with the headings of the notes in the language of the pager and the items in English, which notifies. A pager in English, and notes that were asked for already, end there. Otherwise the pager sends the items, without their scopes, to the control repository, whose Claude translates them with the maintainer's subscription. The pager checks each line: one that lost a reference such as #791 or a name of code keeps its English. Then it edits the message in place, without a notification, and keeps the translation for later changes of the message. Without an answer, the English stays.
